cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check persistence data
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/data/ 2>&1")
print("Data dir:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check logs for more
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 5 --nostream 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("\nLogs:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
